fields.Participants: Marketplace Mgr, Finance, AP/Treasury (links to VS-15/VS-18), Seller

workflows.name: Marketplace Commission, Fee Deduction & Seller Payout

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-record of "records" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-post of "posts settlement entries" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-516 (ensure controlled execution — Marketplace Settlement, Seller Performance & Governance (PA-95.3).)
- operational: automated reconciliation and dispute window
Pain Points / Risks: - **Payout-error risk**: Incorrect settlement damages seller trust; mitigated by automated reconciliation and dispute window
System Touchpoints: - Settlement engine; AP/payout (links to VS-15/VS-18); tax (links to VS-79); records (links to VS-88)

steps.activity: System computes per-seller settlement: gross GMV (links to VS-10) − commission % (W3141) − fees (listing, fulfillment, advertising — W3141/W3152) − returns/refunds (W3151) − withholding tax (W3157) − holdback reserve; produce seller statement
Finance/AP (links to VS-15) review settlement; reconcile to order/returns records; resolve disputes; Treasury (links to VS-18) disburse net payout to seller's verified bank account
System posts settlement entries: marketplace revenue (commission/fees), VAT output (W3157), AP to seller, withholdings remitted to BIR (links to VS-79); archive statement per records (links to VS-88)

fields.Participants: Marketplace Mgr, Seller Operations, BI (links to VS-28), Finance

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-track of "tracking rate, return rate, customer-satisfaction" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-assign of "assign performance tier" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-log of "catalog/buy-box, hold payout reserve" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-516 (ensure controlled execution — Marketplace Settlement, Seller Performance & Governance (PA-95.3).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Gaming risk**: Sellers manipulate metrics (e.g., pressure customers for positive reviews); mitigated by verified-purchase reviews and audit
System Touchpoints: - Seller scorecard (links to VS-28); commission/benefits (links to W3141/W3143); offboarding (links to W3144)

steps.activity: BI (links to VS-28) compute per-seller KPIs: order defect rate, cancellation rate, late-ship rate, valid tracking rate, return rate, customer-satisfaction (CSAT/NPS), dispute rate, listing-quality; benchmark vs. peers
Marketplace Mgr assign performance tier (Excellent / Good / Warning / At-Risk / Suspended) per thresholds; trigger benefits (W3143) or remediation/penalty path; communicate to seller
For At-Risk/Suspended: Seller Operations implement Performance Improvement Plan, restrict catalog/buy-box, hold payout reserve; escalate to offboarding (W3144) if uncorrected

fields.Participants: Marketplace Mgr, CS (links to VS-13), Seller, Quality, Finance
fields.Trigger: Customer complaint about 3P order; seller-buyer dispute

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-count of "counterfeit" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-document of "Marketplace Mgr mediate dispute between buyer and seller" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-track of "track complaint themes and per-seller dispute rate to scorecard" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-516 (ensure controlled execution — Marketplace Settlement, Seller Performance & Governance (PA-95.3).)
- operational: documented dispute policy and transparent evidence-based decisions
Pain Points / Risks: - **Bias-perception risk**: Marketplace seen as favoring seller over buyer (or vice versa); mitigated by documented dispute policy and transparent evidence-based decisions
System Touchpoints: - CS ticketing (links to VS-13); dispute module; refund (links to VS-80); settlement (links to W3153)

steps.activity: CS (links to VS-13) capture complaint: not-as-described, defective, counterfeit (escalate W3156), wrong item, late delivery; route to seller with SLA for response
Marketplace Mgr mediate dispute between buyer and seller; evaluate evidence (photos, listing, comms); decide remedy (refund, replacement, partial credit, deny); document decision
Finance execute remedy (refund — links to VS-80, settlement debit — W3153); track complaint themes and per-seller dispute rate to scorecard (W3154); drive systemic fixes

fields.Participants: Marketplace Mgr, Brand Protection (links to VS-71), Legal, LP (links to VS-23), Seller Operations
fields.Trigger: Brand-owner complaint (links to VS-71); customer counterfeit report; automated detection

workflows.name: Seller Fraud, Counterfeit & Policy Violation Handling

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-review of "review manipulation, payment fraud" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-document of "Marketplace Mgr/Legal investigate" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-record of "records" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - operational: KYB (W3138), monitoring, and decisive action
Pain Points / Risks: - **Counterfeit-reputation risk**: Counterfeits damage BuildRight brand and customer trust; mitigated by KYB (W3138), monitoring, and decisive action
System Touchpoints: - Anti-counterfeit (links to VS-71); fraud (links to VS-23); payout hold (links to W3153); records (links to VS-88)

steps.activity: Brand Protection/LP detect violation: counterfeit (links to VS-71), unauthorized seller, IP infringement, prohibited items (hazmat — links to VS-24, recalled — links to VS-89), review manipulation, payment fraud (links to W3147)

Marketplace Mgr/Legal investigate: evidence (test buy, document review), seller response opportunity, decide action (listing removal, account restriction, suspension, termination — W3144, legal referral)

Execute action: remove listings, withhold payout (links to W3153), refund affected buyers (links to VS-80), report to authorities (DTI/NPC/IP owner) where required, retain records (links to VS-88); feed into seller scoring (W3154)

fields.Participants: Tax Mgr, Finance, Marketplace Mgr, Seller, Legal
fields.Trigger: Order transaction; payout cycle; BIR filing

workflows.name: Marketplace Tax (VAT / Percentage Tax) & BIR Compliance per Seller

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-create of "CREATE/train law and BIR marketplace rules" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-generate of "generate BIR-compliant invoices" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System continuous audit of "Tax Mgr remit BuildRight VAT/EWT" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - operational: structured tax design and ongoing review
Pain Points / Risks: - **Tax-mis-classification risk**: Wrong VAT treatment triggers BIR assessment; mitigated by structured tax design and ongoing review
System Touchpoints: - Tax engine (links to VS-79); BIR eFPS/e-invoicing (links to VS-79); settlement (links to W3153)

steps.activity: Tax Mgr structure marketplace taxation: distinguish BuildRight-as-marketplace-operator revenue (commission/fees — VATable) from seller revenue (sale of goods — VAT/percentage tax per seller's BIR status); apply withholding obligations per CREATE/train law and BIR marketplace rules

System compute per-transaction: VAT on BuildRight commission; pass-through of seller VAT/percentage tax to buyer where applicable; creditable withholding tax (EWT/CWT) on seller payout per BIR rules; generate BIR-compliant invoices (links to VS-79)
Tax Mgr remit BuildRight VAT/EWT (links to VS-79); issue Form 2307 to sellers for withheld tax; sellers remit own output VAT/income tax; facilitate BIR audit response (links to VS-21)

fields.Participants: Marketplace Mgr, CS (links to VS-13), Legal, Finance, Marketing (links to VS-14)
fields.Trigger: Marketplace launch; trust incident; program review

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-count of "counterfeit guarantee, holdback fund for unfulfilled orders" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-communication of "communicate guarantee to buyers" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-report of "report claims cost and trust-score uplift" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-516 (ensure controlled execution — Marketplace Settlement, Seller Performance & Governance (PA-95.3).)
- operational: claim review, evidence, and abuse monitoring (links to VS-23)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Claim-abuse risk**: Fraudulent buyer claims drain fund; mitigated by claim review, evidence, and abuse monitoring (links to VS-23)
System Touchpoints: - CS/trust module (links to VS-13); reserve (links to VS-17); marketing (links to VS-14)

steps.activity: Marketplace Mgr/Legal define buyer-protection policy: A-to-Z-style guarantee (refund if seller fails to deliver/resolve), money-back window, item-not-as-described remedy, counterfeit guarantee, holdback fund for unfulfilled orders (links to W3144)
CS (links to VS-13) operate trust program: clear claim path, fast adjudication, proactive outreach on systemic issues; Marketing (links to VS-14) communicate guarantee to buyers
Finance fund buyer-protection reserve from marketplace fees; report claims cost and trust-score uplift; calibrate policy to balance buyer trust and seller fairness

fields.Participants: DPO, Marketplace Mgr, Legal, IT Security (links to VS-27), Seller
fields.Trigger: Marketplace launch; DPA obligations; privacy incident

workflows.name: Marketplace Data Privacy, Seller Data Governance & DPA Compliance

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-document of "DPO map marketplace data flows" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-notify of "notify affected customers, investigate, remediate, and apply seller sanctions…" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - operational: minimal-disclosure design, processor agreement, and audit
Pain Points / Risks: - **PII-leak risk**: Seller mishandles customer PII; mitigated by minimal-disclosure design, processor agreement, and audit
System Touchpoints: - Privacy/ROPA (links to VS-91); data masking; incident response (links to VS-91 PA-91.3); IT security (links to VS-27)

steps.activity: DPO map marketplace data flows: customer PII shared with seller (name, address, phone) for fulfillment — Data Privacy Act (DPA) processor/controller arrangement; seller-as-processor agreement; document ROPA (links to VS-91)

DPO implement seller data governance: minimal PII disclosure (e.g., masked phone, address only), retention limits, security requirements for seller handling of PII (links to VS-27), privacy-by-design in portal/API
On breach (seller or platform): execute 72-hour NPC notification (links to VS-91 PA-91.3), notify affected customers, investigate, remediate, and apply seller sanctions if seller-attributable

fields.Participants: Marketplace Director, Finance, BI (links to VS-28), Ecommerce (links to VS-10), Category (links to VS-01)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-log of "technology amortization, buyer-protection reserve, contribution margin" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-count of "count/active, SKUs, category mix, buyer conversion, basket size,…" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-review of "reviews P&L and growth" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-516 (ensure controlled execution — Marketplace Settlement, Seller Performance & Governance (PA-95.3).)
- operational: milestone-gated investment and clear take-rate target
Pain Points / Risks: - **Unit-economics risk**: Sub-scale marketplace burns cash; mitigated by milestone-gated investment and clear take-rate target
System Touchpoints: - BI dashboards (links to VS-28); financial cost model (links to VS-17); retail-media (links to VS-48)

steps.activity: BI/Finance (links to VS-28) compute marketplace P&L: GMV, take-rate (commission+fees ÷ GMV), net revenue, returns/chargebacks, ops cost (CS, fraud, payouts), technology amortization, buyer-protection reserve, contribution margin

Marketplace Director analyze growth: GMV trend, seller count/active, SKUs, category mix, buyer conversion, basket size, repeat-purchase, share of ecommerce (vs. 1P); benchmark vs. external marketplaces (links to VS-65)

Steering committee reviews P&L and growth; reallocates investment (seller acquisition, technology, retail-media — links to VS-48), adjusts commission (W3141), refines strategy (W3137); report to Board (links to VS-36)
